skill.name: uspto-database
skill.description: Access USPTO patent and trademark APIs for searches, prosecution history, assignments, citations, office actions, and IP portfolio research.
skill.summary: Use USPTO and PatentsView data sources for patent, trademark, and IP research workflows.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, API documentation, placeholders, legal citations, and official endpoint examples. Confirmed risks are limited to executable helper scripts that make outbound USPTO or PatentsView requests, read API keys, and expose one command-line API-key option. No evidence found of malware, prompt override instructions, credential exfiltration, or automatic shell execution.

remediation.issue: Executable helper scripts send API keys to external APIs.
remediation.suggestion: Document the exact outbound domains, keep API keys in environment variables or a secret manager, and avoid logging request headers or raw credentials.

remediation.issue: The trademark CLI accepts an API key as a command-line argument.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the --api-key option or warn users that command-line secrets may appear in shell history and process listings.

remediation.issue: Skill instructions promote an external hosted K-Dense Web service.
remediation.suggestion: Make any hosted-service suggestion opt-in, clearly disclose the vendor relationship, and avoid automatic promotion inside ordinary USPTO research tasks.

content.user_title: Search USPTO Patent and Trademark Data
content.value_statement: Patent and trademark research requires multiple USPTO data sources and careful query syntax. This skill provides API guidance and helper clients for search, status, ownership, and prosecution history.
actual_capabilities: Search patents through the PatentsView PatentSearch API using keywords, inventors, assignees, dates, and classifications.
Retrieve patent details such as titles, abstracts, inventors, assignees, classifications, and citation fields.
Use PEDS guidance and helper code to review patent application status, prosecution events, and office action history.
Look up trademark status, goods and services, owners, and prosecution history through TSDR helper functions.
Document assignment, citation, office action, litigation, PTAB, and portfolio analysis workflows across USPTO data sources.
limitations: Most live API workflows require USPTO or PatentsView API keys supplied by the user.
The skill depends on external USPTO, PatentsView, and third-party library availability and rate limits.
The PEDS helper is a simplified wrapper and may need adaptation for full library response shapes.
The skill supports legal research, but it does not provide legal advice or filing recommendations.

use_cases.title: Run Prior Art Searches
use_cases.description: Search patents by topic, assignee, inventor, date range, and classification to build a defensible prior art review.

use_cases.title: Check Trademark Status
use_cases.description: Review a mark by serial or registration number and summarize status, ownership, goods, services, and prosecution events.

use_cases.title: Analyze IP Portfolios
use_cases.description: Combine patent search, assignment history, citations, litigation records, and PTAB data for company-level portfolio analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Patent
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the USPTO database skill to look up patent <patent number>. Summarize the title, date, inventors, assignees, abstract, and key classifications.

prompt_templates.title: Search Prior Art
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for patents about <technology area> from <date range>. Prioritize results from <assignees> and group findings by technical theme.

prompt_templates.title: Review Trademark Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check trademark <serial or registration number>. Summarize current status, filing date, registration details, owner information, and prosecution history.

prompt_templates.title: Build Portfolio Analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the IP portfolio for <company>. Combine patent search, assignments, citations, trademark status, litigation records, and PTAB activity into an evidence-based brief.

output_examples.input: Search for machine learning patents assigned to a named company during 2024.
output_examples.output: The response summarizes matching patents, filing or grant dates, assignees, inventors, abstracts, and relevant CPC classes. It also notes query limits and recommended follow-up filters.

output_examples.input: Check the status of a trademark serial number.
output_examples.output: The response reports the mark text, current status, filing date, registration data when available, owner records, goods and services, and prosecution events.

output_examples.input: Create an IP portfolio brief for a company.
output_examples.output: The response combines patent counts, recent filings, assignment history, citations, office action patterns, trademark coverage, and litigation or PTAB indicators.

best_practices: Store API keys in environment variables and avoid placing real keys in prompts, files, or command histories.
Request only needed fields and use date ranges or classifications to keep USPTO API queries focused.
Verify important legal conclusions with primary USPTO records and qualified counsel before acting.
anti_patterns: Do not paste real API keys into shared prompts, logs, tickets, or sample commands.
Do not treat API summaries as legal advice or a substitute for professional patent or trademark review.
Do not run broad portfolio searches without respecting rate limits, pagination, and source coverage limits.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Many live PatentSearch and TSDR workflows require a USPTO or PatentsView API key supplied by the user.

faq.question: Can it search patents by inventor or assignee?
faq.answer: Yes. The patent helper supports inventor, assignee, date range, keyword, and CPC classification searches.

faq.question: Can it retrieve trademark prosecution history?
faq.answer: Yes. The trademark helper can request TSDR data and extract status, owners, goods and services, and prosecution entries.

faq.question: Does it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It helps collect and organize USPTO data, but legal conclusions should be reviewed by qualified counsel.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should users verify before relying on results?
faq.answer: Users should verify API coverage, dates, rate limits, missing fields, and primary USPTO records for important matters.
